contexts.text: They who from the heat of the love of self... AR 756. Signified.
With those who labour with a superabundance of heat... CL 459.
It is only the heat of the flesh... CL 488:2.
With such a venereal heat are they excited. SE 3207.
As they are taken with no other heat than this, they have lost all that pleasureableness which otherwise attends what is venereal.
He was amazed that he had so suddenly blazed with venereal heat.
The other kind have not such a heat of exercising command.
In their blind heat they were carried into... Hell.
